title: playbook list --json
description: Every root active in the context, with its kind and the active members of its family.

pstack.description: pstack version, from the plugin manifest or a folder named like a version. null when neither gives one.

kind.description: pstack for a bundled playbook, team for a file in the checkout's .agents/playbooks, user for a file in the config dir.

items.description: A playbook file's stem: a bundled playbook's, a team file's or a user file's.

family.description: The active members other than the root, in apply order.
